title: Claude 4 System Card
paper_type_zh: 闭源前沿模型系统卡与透明度披露
best_for_zh: 比较闭源前沿模型数据与反馈披露边界的读者
one_line: Claude 4's system card and transparency materials name broad source categories, human feedback, and Constitutional AI, but do not disclose record-level data, reward, or environment contracts.
Claude 4 的系统卡和透明度材料列出广义来源类别、人工反馈与 Constitutional AI，但未披露记录级数据、奖励或环境合约。
why: It supplies an independent closed-frontier baseline for distinguishing high-level alignment disclosure from auditable reasoning-data and feedback provenance.
inclusion_reason: A high-impact system-card disclosure baseline that names broad source categories, human feedback, and Constitutional AI while retaining the record-level data and feedback ledger as undisclosed.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The Claude 4 System Card introduces Claude Opus 4 and Claude Sonnet 4 as hybrid reasoning models and primarily documents pre-deployment safety testing, alignment assessment, reward-hacking evaluation, and Responsible Scaling Policy decisions. It also contains a short but concrete training-data disclosure.

The curation problem is to preserve both sides of that asymmetry. Anthropic identifies source classes, cleaning methods, human feedback, Constitutional AI, selected character-trait training, and crowd-worker roles, but does not release the records or feedback contracts that implement them. Evaluation transcripts and benchmark results provide safety evidence; they are not automatically post-training data.

Claude 4 System Card 将 Claude Opus 4 和 Claude Sonnet 4 介绍为 hybrid reasoning models，主要记录部署前安全测试、对齐评估、reward-hacking 评测和 Responsible Scaling Policy 决策，同时也给出一段简短但具体的训练数据披露。

策展问题是同时保留这两方面的不对称。Anthropic 说明了来源类别、清洗方法、人工反馈、Constitutional AI、selected character-trait training 和众包工作者角色，却没有发布实现这些过程的记录或反馈契约。评测转录和基准结果属于安全证据，不能自动视为后训练数据。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The report says both models were trained on a proprietary mixture of public Internet information as of March 2025, non-public third-party data, data from labeling services and paid contractors, opted-in Claude user data, and internally generated Anthropic data. Cleaning includes deduplication and classification. Crowd workers contribute preference selection, safety evaluation, and adversarial testing.

For helpful, honest, and harmless behavior, Anthropic names human feedback, Constitutional AI based on principles including the UN Universal Declaration of Human Rights, and training selected character traits. These are meaningful classes of data and feedback, but the item schema, constitution used for Claude 4, preference aggregation, scalar reward, reward model, calibration, and stage allocation are unknown. The Card therefore records a disclosure boundary, not a reusable preference corpus.

报告称，两款模型使用专有混合数据训练：截至 2025 年 3 月的公开互联网信息、第三方非公开数据、数据标注服务与付费承包商提供的数据、选择同意用于训练的 Claude 用户数据，以及 Anthropic 内部生成的数据。清洗过程包括去重和分类；众包工作者参与偏好选择、安全评估和对抗测试。

为形成 helpful、honest、harmless 行为，Anthropic 点名了人工反馈、基于包括《世界人权宣言》在内原则的 Constitutional AI，以及 selected character-trait training。这些是有意义的数据与反馈类别，但 Claude 4 的条目模式、具体 constitution、偏好聚合、标量奖励、奖励模型、校准和阶段分配均为 unknown。因此，本 Card 记录的是披露边界，而不是可复用偏好语料。

title: Method
方法
html:
The public-web component is collected with a general-purpose crawler that follows robots.txt, avoids password-protected, sign-in, and CAPTCHA-gated pages, and is identifiable to site operators. Anthropic reports data diligence, deduplication, and classification, followed by broad pretraining and alignment using human feedback, Constitutional AI, and selected character traits. It does not disclose record counts, mixture weights, revisions, source-level licenses, annotator prompts, synthetic generator settings, preference formats, reward computation, optimizer, rollout budget, or checkpoints.

The report evaluates multiple helpful-honest-harmless snapshots, helpful-only snapshots with safeguards/harmlessness training removed, and final candidates, in standard and extended thinking where possible. RSP assessment combines automated evaluation, standardized benchmarks, uplift trials, internal and external red teaming, and expert review. These evaluation and release-governance processes are documented evidence, but the report does not establish that their records trained the released models.

公开网页部分由通用 crawler 收集：遵守 robots.txt，不访问密码保护、需要登录或 CAPTCHA 的页面，并允许网站运营者识别爬虫。Anthropic 报告了数据尽调、去重与分类，随后进行广泛预训练，并用人工反馈、Constitutional AI 和 selected character traits 对齐。报告未披露记录数、混合权重、版本、逐来源许可证、标注提示、合成生成器设置、偏好格式、奖励计算、优化器、rollout 预算或检查点。

报告评测了多类快照：helpful-honest-harmless 快照、移除 safeguards/harmlessness training 的 helpful-only 快照，以及最终候选；在可行时同时测试 standard 和 extended thinking。RSP 评估结合自动评测、标准化基准、uplift trial、内部/外部红队和专家审查。这些评测与发布治理流程是已记录证据，但报告没有证明相关记录被用于训练发布模型。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The primary evidence is Anthropic's Claude 4 System Card PDF, titled System Card: Claude Opus 4 & Claude Sonnet 4 and dated May 2025. Sections 1.1.1–1.1.3 directly support the source mixture, cleaning, alignment-technique, extended-thinking, and crowd-worker claims. Anthropic's Transparency Hub is the official publication context.

The report's extensive safeguards, alignment, reward-hacking, CBRN, autonomy, cyber, and third-party assessments support a release-audit ledger. They do not provide corpus manifests or a reward contract. A reported finding that reasoning transcripts can omit important influences is also a caution against treating visible or summarized chain of thought as faithful process supervision.

主要证据是 Anthropic 于 2025 年 5 月发布、题为 System Card: Claude Opus 4 & Claude Sonnet 4 的 Claude 4 System Card PDF。其中 §1.1.1–§1.1.3 直接支持来源混合、清洗、对齐技术、extended thinking 和众包工作者相关主张；Anthropic 的 Transparency Hub是官方发布语境。

报告中的 safeguards、对齐、reward hacking、CBRN、自主性、网络安全和第三方评估支持发布审计账本，但不提供语料清单或奖励契约。报告还指出，推理转录可能遗漏影响模型行为的重要信息，这也提醒读者不要把可见或经摘要的 chain of thought 当作忠实过程监督。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The report's atlas contribution is comparative disclosure, not a new open alignment dataset. It is unusually explicit about several source classes, opted-in user data, deduplication/classification, crowd-worker functions, and the distinction between helpful-only, broadly safety-trained, and final snapshots. At the same time, it withholds the operational preference and reward pipeline.

This combination is useful because it reveals a boundary between governance evidence and data evidence. Iterative safety evaluations can influence release decisions and motivate mitigations without becoming a released training corpus. Human feedback and Constitutional AI are established approaches rather than new methods here; the direction signal is how a frontier system card connects them to model snapshots and risk-governance decisions while leaving record-level lineage unavailable.

该报告对本图谱的贡献是可比较的披露，而不是新的开放对齐数据集。它较明确地列出多类来源、opt-in 用户数据、去重/分类、众包工作者职能，以及 helpful-only、广泛安全训练和最终快照之间的区别；与此同时，操作层面的偏好与奖励流水线仍未公开。

这种组合有助于揭示治理证据与数据证据之间的边界：迭代安全评测可以影响发布决策并促成缓解措施，却不因此成为已发布训练语料。人工反馈和 Constitutional AI 在此并非新方法；真正的方向信号在于，前沿系统卡如何把它们与模型快照和风险治理决策连接，同时仍缺少记录级谱系。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The report does not release source manifests, per-source rights, mixture weights, record or token counts, immutable versions, annotation instructions, preference examples, constitutions applied to Claude 4, disagreement handling, reward models, scalar labels, calibration, rollout pools, rejected records, optimizer settings, checkpoints, train/evaluation splits, or comprehensive decontamination evidence. Crowd-worker standards do not substitute for an item-level labor and quality ledger.

The evaluation material is broad but heterogeneous and often uses undisclosed evaluation instructions, tools, classifiers, simulated environments, or expert protocols that are not packaged as reusable artifacts. Some long extended-thinking traces are summarized by a smaller model, and the report says reasoning transcripts can omit behaviorally important information. Benchmark and safety results therefore cannot prove training-data quality or reasoning faithfulness.

报告未发布来源清单、逐来源权利、混合权重、记录或 token 数、不可变版本、标注指引、偏好样本、Claude 4 实际使用的 constitution、分歧处理、奖励模型、标量标签、校准、rollout pool、被拒记录、优化器设置、检查点、训练/评测划分或全面去污染证据。众包工作标准不能替代条目级劳动与质量账本。

评测材料虽然广泛，但高度异质，且常使用未披露的评测指令、工具、分类器、模拟环境或专家协议，这些内容也没有打包为可复用工件。部分较长 extended-thinking 轨迹由较小模型摘要，报告也指出推理转录可能遗漏影响行为的重要信息。因此，基准和安全结果不能证明训练数据质量或推理忠实性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Within frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger, this Card provides a closed-model comparison point with unusually clear source-class and evaluation-governance disclosures. It helps reviewers separate training ingredients, human labor roles, alignment labels, visible reasoning interfaces, iterative safety evaluation, and final deployment decisions.

For post-training audits, it motivates requests for source and rights manifests, preference-record schemas, the actual constitutional prompts or principles used, reward and calibration details, snapshot lineage, mitigation-data provenance, split and decontamination evidence, and release-version logs. It should not be used as evidence of a reusable preference dataset, a disclosed verifier, or an environment suitable for replay.

在 frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger 中，本 Card 提供了一个闭源模型比较点，其来源类别和评测治理披露相对清楚。它帮助审阅者区分训练成分、人工劳动角色、对齐标签、可见推理接口、迭代安全评测和最终部署决策。

对后训练审计而言，它提示应索取来源与权利清单、偏好记录模式、实际使用的宪法提示或原则、奖励与校准细节、快照谱系、缓解数据溯源、划分与去污染证据，以及发布版本日志。它不应被当作可复用偏好数据集、已披露验证器或可回放环境的证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Start with §§1.1.1–1.1.3 for the direct data, cleaning, alignment, and crowd-worker disclosures.
  • Separate preference selection, safety evaluation, and adversarial testing as different worker-produced objects.
  • Treat helpful-only, safety-trained, and final snapshots as evaluation strata, not released checkpoints or datasets.
  • Keep benchmark, red-team, and reasoning-transcript results separate from evidence about training-data quality.

• 先读 §1.1.1–§1.1.3，核对数据、清洗、对齐和众包工作者的直接披露。
  • 将偏好选择、安全评估和对抗测试视为不同的人工生产对象。
  • 将 helpful-only、安全训练和最终快照视为评测层次，而不是已发布检查点或数据集。
  • 将基准、红队和推理转录结果与训练数据质量证据分开。
